records.jp: （二人は……まだ来てないか）
records.en_original: (The citrus sisters aren't here yet.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The citrus sisters aren't here yet.)
records.en: (Those two...aren't here yet.)

records.jp: （今朝はたいしたニュースもないなー……ん？<CR>またこのロック歌手、全国ツアーするんだ）
records.en_original: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en: (No big news this morning... Hm?<CR>That rock singer's going on another nationwide tour.)

records.jp: （今朝は大したニュースも無いなー……ん？<CR>またこのロック歌手、全国ツアーするんだ）
records.en_original: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en: (No big news this morning... Hm?<CR>That rock singer's going on another nationwide tour.)

records.jp: （すごいなぁ、もう結構な年のはずなのに。<CR>服装や髪形もド派手だし）
records.en_original: (Wow, how does he do it? He's getting up there in years. But he's still got style, I'll give him that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wow, how does he do it? He's getting up there in years, but he's still got style, I'll give him that.)
records.en: (Wow. He must be getting pretty old by now,<CR>but his clothes and hair are still so flashy.)

records.jp: （二人が来たら聞いてみよう）
records.en_original: (I'll have to show those two if they ever show up...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll have to show those two if they ever show up...)
records.en: (I'll ask those two when they get here.)

records.jp: ねえ！
records.en_original: Hey!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey!
records.en: Hey!

records.en_original: Y-Yes?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yes?
records.en: Wh-What...?

records.jp: あなた、魔法少女でしょ！
records.en_original: You're a magical girl, aren't you?!
records.en_auxiliary: You're a magical girl, aren't you?!
records.en: You're a magical girl, aren't you?!

records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!

records.jp: それとも宇宙刑事？<CR>はたまた異世界から来たエージェントってやつ？
records.en_original: Or maybe you're a space detective? Like maybe an agent from another world?
records.en_auxiliary: Or maybe you're a space detective? Like maybe an agent from another world?
records.en: Or maybe you're a Space Sheriff?<CR>Or one of those agents from another world?

records.jp: な、なんなの突然。ていうか、あなた、いったい誰？
records.en_original: Wh-What's with the weird badgering? And who ARE you, anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what's with the weird badgering? And who are you, anyway?
records.en: Wh-What's with you all of a sudden? And who are you, anyway?

records.jp: そういえばまだ話したことなかったっけ。<CR>わたしは一之瀬亜子！　放送部なの
records.en_original: Oh, right, we've never talked before, have we? I'm Ako Ichinose! I'm in the broadcasting club.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, right, we've never talked before, have we? I'm Ako Ichinose! I'm in the broadcasting club.
records.en: Oh, right. We haven't spoken before, have we?<CR>I'm Ichinose Ako, from the broadcasting club!

records.jp: ……放送部？
records.en_original: ...There's a "broadcasting club"?
records.en_auxiliary: The broadcasting club?
records.en: ...Broadcasting club?

records.jp: この学校に関する事件を調べて記事にしてるの！
records.en_original: I investigate incidents around our school, and write them up as features and interest pieces!
records.en_auxiliary: I investigate incidents around our school, and write them up as features and interest pieces!
records.en: I investigate incidents at this school and write articles about them!

records.jp: ……話が全然見えないんだけど、<CR>その放送部さんが、なんで私に？
records.en_original: What would someone from the broadcasting club want with me, anyway? There's no story here.
records.en_auxiliary: What would someone from the broadcasting club want with me? There's no story here.
records.en: ...I'm completely lost.<CR>Why does someone from the broadcasting club want me?

records.jp: 時季外れの転校生！　謎めいた雰囲気に人間関係！<CR>わたしのジャーナリストとしての勘が告げてるの！
records.en_original: Are you kidding? You're a mid-year transfer student with a mysterious past! My journalistic instincts are running wild!
records.en_auxiliary: Are you kidding? You're a mid-year transfer student with a mysterious past! My journalistic instincts are running wild!
records.en: A late transfer! A mysterious aura and suspicious connections!<CR>My journalistic instincts are screaming!

records.jp: これはどこかの国のエージェントか異星人、<CR>あるいは変身ヒーローだって！
records.en_original: You must an agent from some foreign country, or another planet, or maybe a hero in disguise!
records.en_auxiliary: You must be an agent from some foreign country, or another planet, or maybe a hero in disguise!
records.en: You must be a foreign agent, an alien,<CR>or maybe a transforming superhero!

records.jp: ……私、転校生じゃないよ？
records.en_original: ...You're going to need to check your sources. I'm not a transfer student.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're going to need to check your sources. I'm not a transfer student.
records.en: ...I'm not a transfer student, you know?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 事情があって最近まで登校できてなかっただけで、<CR>最初からこの学校に入学してたよ
records.en_original: Circumstances beyond my control kept me from attending, but I've been enrolled in this school all along.
records.en_auxiliary: Circumstances beyond my control kept me from attending, but I've been enrolled in this school all along.
records.en: I just couldn't come to school until recently because of...circumstances.<CR>I've been enrolled here from the beginning.

records.jp: そんなぁ。せっかくネタになると思ったのに……
records.en_original: Nooooo! Awwwww, I thought I had a story here, too...
records.en_auxiliary: Nooooo! Aww, I thought I had a story here, too...
records.en: Aww... I thought I finally had a story...

records.jp: なんか……ごめん。でもどうしてそんな突拍子もないこと考えたの？<CR>私がその……魔法少女だなんて
records.en_original: I...probably shouldn't ask, but what gave you that crazy idea in the first place? That I was...a magical girl?
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to dash your hopes. But what gave you that crazy idea in the first place? That I was...a magical girl.
records.en: Um...sorry. But what made you jump to something so ridiculous?<CR>Me being, uh...a magical girl.

records.jp: それは白井ちゃんの隣にいる二人のせいだよ！
records.en_original: It's because you're always hanging out with those two girls!
records.en_auxiliary: It's because you're always hanging out with those two girls!
records.en: It's because of those two girls who are always beside you, Shirai-chan!

records.jp: ユズとライムのこと？
records.en_original: Yuzu and Lime?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and Lime?
records.en: Yuzu and Lime?

records.jp: うん。あの二人、いつからいたのか、<CR>まったくわからないんだよねー
records.en_original: Yeah. They're REAL enigmas, those two. Nobody even knows when they first showed up here.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. They're REAL enigmas, those two. Nobody even knows when they first showed up here.
records.en: Yeah. No one has any idea<CR>when those two first appeared.

records.jp: え、最初からいたんじゃないの？
records.en_original: Were they not here from the beginning?
records.en_auxiliary: Were they not here from the beginning?
records.en: Huh? Weren't they here from the beginning?

records.jp: 少なくとも入学式の写真には写ってないんだよ。なのに、<CR>いつの間にか当たり前のようにクラスにいて……怪しいでしょ？
records.en_original: They're not in the photos from the entrance ceremony. Yet suddenly, they were part of the clas... Suspicious, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: They're not in the photos from the entrance ceremony. Yet suddenly, they were part of the class... Suspicious, huh?
records.en: They're not even in the entrance ceremony photos.<CR>Then one day they were simply part of the class... Suspicious, right?

records.jp: そ、そうだね
records.en_original: I'll say...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll say...
records.en: Y-Yeah, I guess.

records.jp: ねえ、一緒にあの二人のことを調べてみようよ！
records.en_original: Hey, let's investigate them together!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, let's investigate them together!
records.en: Hey, let's investigate them together!

records.jp: え、なんで私が？
records.en_original: Huh, why me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, why me?
records.en: Huh, why me?

records.jp: だって白井ちゃん、放課後とか、結構あの二人と一緒にいるし
records.en_original: Well, duh. You hang out with them after school all the time!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, duh. You hang out with them after school all the time!
records.en: Because you spend a lot of time with those two after school, Shirai-chan.

records.jp: クラスの隣人が素性不明とか、気にならない？
records.en_original: Come on, the girls you sit next to in class are total mysteries! Aren't you a little curious?
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, the girls you sit next to in class are total mysteries! Aren't you a little curious?
records.en: Wouldn't you be curious if the girls sitting beside you were complete mysteries?

records.jp: それは、まあ……
records.en_original: Well, sort of...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, sort of...
records.en: Well, sort of...

records.jp: よし決まり！　じゃあ一緒に探っていこう！
records.en_original: Then it's decided! We're investigation partners!
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's decided! We're investigation partners!
records.en: Then it's settled! Let's investigate them together!

records.jp: おっはよー！
records.en_original: Morniiiing!
records.en_auxiliary: Morniiiing!
records.en: Morniiiing!

records.jp: じゃ、よろしくね！
records.en_original: See ya 'round, partner!
records.en_auxiliary: See ya 'round, partner!
records.en: Okay, partner. I'm counting on you!

records.jp: おはよー、ヒナちゃん。あっちゃんとお話なんてめずらしいね
records.en_original: Morning, Hina. I didn't know you were friends with Akky!
records.en_auxiliary: Morning, Hina. I didn't know you were friends with Akky!
records.en: Morning, Hina-chan. It's rare to see you talking with Acchan.

records.jp: というか初めてじゃない？<CR>何かあったの？
records.en_original: In fact, I'm fairly certain that's the first time you've met. What'd she say to you?
records.en_auxiliary: In fact, isn't that the first time you've met? What'd she say to you?
records.en: Actually, isn't this the first time?<CR>Did something happen?

records.jp: べ、別に。たいしたことじゃないよ
records.en_original: N-Nothing much, we just chatted.
records.en_auxiliary: N-nothing much, we just chatted.
records.en: N-Nothing much, we just chatted.

records.jp: ふーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: （今朝は大したニュースも無いなー……ん？<CR>またこのロック歌手、全国ツアーするんだ）
records.en_original: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Nothing major in the news this morning... Oh, hey, that one rock singer's going on tour again.)
records.en: (No big news this morning... Hm?<CR>That rock singer's going on another nationwide tour.)
